# The implement step loads the review skill from the plugin folder that the engine builds, so the CLI names it with the prefix of that plugin.
# The call counts as the skill that vars.review_skill names, and the item goes on to the review.
exec beehave run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star
stdout 'item 7 finished'
grep -count=1 '^implement ' calls.log
grep '^review ' calls.log

-- plugin-skill --
-- verdicts --
approve
approve
